questions.sourceEnglish: I put things off so long that my well-being or efficiency unnecessarily suffers
questions.publishedChinese: 我把事情拖得太久, 以至于我的幸福感或效率受到了不必要的负面影响
questions.platformChinese: 我把事情拖得太久, 以至于我的幸福感或效率受到了不必要的负面影响

questions.sourceEnglish: If there is something I should do, I get to it before attending to lesser tasks
questions.publishedChinese: 如果有我该做的事情, 我会先去做这件事, 然后再去处理其它次要的任务
questions.platformChinese: 如果有我该做的事情, 我会先去做这件事, 然后再去处理其它次要的任务

questions.sourceEnglish: My life would be better if I did some activities or tasks earlier
questions.publishedChinese: 如果我早点儿开始做某些活动或任务的话, 我的生活会更好
questions.platformChinese: 如果我早点儿开始做某些活动或任务的话, 我的生活会更好

questions.sourceEnglish: When I should be doing one thing, I will do another
questions.publishedChinese: 当我应该做某件事情时, 我反而会去做另一件事
questions.platformChinese: 当我应该做某件事情时, 我反而会去做另一件事

questions.sourceEnglish: At the end of the day, I know I could have spent the time better
questions.publishedChinese: 回顾当天, 我知道我本可以更好地使用我的时间
questions.platformChinese: 回顾当天, 我知道我本可以更好地使用我的时间

questions.publishedChinese: 我明智地利用我的时间
questions.platformChinese: 我明智地利用我的时间

questions.sourceEnglish: I delay tasks beyond what is reasonable
questions.publishedChinese: 我拖延任务的时间超出了合理范围
questions.platformChinese: 我拖延任务的时间超出了合理范围

questions.sourceEnglish: I do everything when I believe it needs to be done
questions.publishedChinese: 只要我认为某件事情需要完成, 我就会去做它
questions.platformChinese: 只要我认为某件事情需要完成, 我就会去做它
